phytonTests.name: Camera AV Stream Management 2.7
phytonTests.comment: Test wrong assumption: step 27 escalates MaxFrameRate by +20 per maxConcurrentEncoders iteration (starting at minFrameRate+15) then again for the final exhaustion attempt, to force RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; with maxConcurrentEncoders=1 that final attempt requests 65fps, which exceeds our declared VideoSensorParams.MaxFps (60) and is correctly rejected as DYNAMIC_CONSTRAINT_ERROR first, per Matter 1.6/1.5.1 §11.2.8.4.12's own Effect on Receipt order (unsupported-field checks precede the resource check). Any device with a finite MaxFps hits this same issue eventually — it's not specific to our declared value.

phytonTests.name: Camera AV Stream Management 2.18
phytonTests.comment: Test calls request_device_reboot(), which has no real restart mechanism against this container (no --restart-flag-file wired up), so it falls through to a manual-reboot prompt that resolves immediately on empty stdin without actually restarting matterbridge. The 'persists after reboot' assertions pass because nothing was ever cleared, not because real restart persistence was exercised.
